language.name: Galactic Basic
entries: The common trade language of the galaxy, derived from Old Galactic Standard and influenced by many species' tongues.

language.name: Binary
entries: The language of droids, expressed as sequences of beeps and whistles. Many organic species can understand {@language Binary|sw5e-phb|Binary} but cannot speak it.

language.name: Huttese
entries: The language of the Hutts and much of the underworld. Many crime lords insist on communicating in {@language Huttese|sw5e-phb|Huttese}.

language.name: Bith
entries: The language of the Bith, characterized by tonal qualities that other species {@optfeature Perceive|sw5e-phb|perceive} as musical.

language.name: Shyriiwook
entries: The language of Wookiees. Most Wookiees can understand {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb} but cannot speak it due to their vocal anatomy.

language.name: Twi'leki
entries: The spoken language of the Twi'leks. Twi'leks also communicate through subtle lekku gestures.

language.name: Sith
entries: An agglutinative language once associated with the Sith species and later preserved by the Sith Order.
